title: Count Digits
description: Given a non-negative integer n, return how many digits it has. The number 0 has 1 digit.
hints: Converting the number to a string is one option.
Do not forget that 0 still has one digit.

title: Sum of Multiples
description: Given an integer n, return the sum of all positive integers below n that are multiples of 3 or 5. Count a number once even if it is a multiple of both.
hints: Loop over every number from 1 to n - 1.
Use one condition with 'or' so multiples of 15 are not counted twice.
reference_solution:
def solve(n):
    return sum(i for i in range(1, n) if i % 3 == 0 or i % 5 == 0)

title: Character Histogram
description: Given a string s, return a dictionary mapping each character to the number of times it appears. Uppercase and lowercase letters are different characters, and spaces count as characters.
hints: Start with an empty dictionary.
dict.get(c, 0) + 1 avoids checking whether the key exists.

title: Replace Spaces
description: Given a string s, return a new string where every space character is replaced by "%20".

examples.explanation: Each of the two spaces becomes %20.

hints: Strings have a built-in replace method.
Every space is replaced, not just the first.

title: Prefix Sum Array
description: Given a list of integers nums, return a list where element i is the sum of nums[0] through nums[i].
hints: Keep a running total as you loop.
Append the running total to the result after adding each element.
reference_solution:
def solve(nums):
    out = []
    total = 0
    for x in nums:
        total += x
        out.append(total)
    return out

title: Longest Word
description: Given a sentence s, return the longest word in it. Words are separated by whitespace. If several words tie for longest, return the first one. If there are no words, return an empty string.

examples.explanation: "quick" and "brown" both have 5 letters; "quick" comes first.

hints: split() with no argument handles extra spaces.
Only replace your current best when a word is strictly longer, so ties keep the first.

title: Merge Sorted Arrays
description: Given two lists a and b, each sorted in ascending order (and possibly containing duplicates), return one sorted list containing every distinct value from both lists, each value appearing once.

examples.explanation: 3 and 5 appear in both lists but are kept once.

hints: Use one pointer per list and always take the smaller front value.
Before appending, skip the value if it equals the last value you appended.

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description: Given an unsorted list of integers, return the length of the longest run of consecutive integers (for example 3, 4, 5, 6) that can be formed from its values. Duplicates count once. Aim for O(n) time.
hints: Put all values in a set for fast lookup.
Only start counting from a value x when x - 1 is not in the set.
From that start, keep checking x + 1, x + 2, and so on.

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
description: Given a list of integers nums and an integer k, return the number of contiguous, non-empty subarrays whose elements add up to k. The list may contain negative numbers and zeros.

examples.explanation: The subarrays at indices 0-1 and 1-2 both sum to 2.

hints: A subarray sum equals the difference of two prefix sums.
Store how many times each prefix sum has occurred in a dictionary.
At each position, add the count of earlier prefix sums equal to (current prefix - k).

title: Minimum Window With All Characters
description: Given two strings s and t, return the shortest substring of s that contains every character of t, including duplicates (if t has two 'a' characters, the window needs at least two 'a' characters). If no such substring exists, return an empty string. If several windows have the same shortest length, return the leftmost one.

examples.explanation: "BANC" is the shortest substring containing A, B and C.

hints: Count how many of each character t needs.
Expand the right end until the window has everything, then shrink from the left while it still does.
Record the best window each time the window is valid.
